answer: An operator can mint copper only by personally checking in once per epoch. zephyr selects a distant site each epoch; forge verifies that operator’s biometric and keeps every key they control under one count. Check-ins cannot be delegated; copper is nontransferable. Each admitted key consumes copper equal to the square of the resulting key count. Ten clones thus cost 385 copper, earned over 385 sequential attested travel epochs; the tenth key alone costs 100, while an honest newcomer costs one.
